playground.title: Component Playground
playground.description: Every component in the UI library with adjustable props. Changes apply live and use your current style settings.

accordion.description: Closed API over the Radix accordion: the root is fixed to a single collapsible item, so it always renders exactly one section.
accordion.title: Accordion title
accordion.subtitle: Optional second line
accordion.children: Anything passed as children renders inside the collapsible content.

button.description: Plain button element with cva variants. `asChild` swaps the element for a Radix Slot, which is how the menu renders buttons as links.

checkbox.description: Radix checkbox with the tick indicator baked in. Passes every Radix prop straight through, including the indeterminate state.
checkbox.label: Accept the terms

chip.description: Inline label span. The optional icon goes through AppIcon, so it takes the same Hugeicons element or mask url.

drawer.description: Radix dialog in a slide-in panel. Controlled only: it takes open plus onClose and has no trigger of its own.
drawer.title: Drawer content
drawer.body: The title is rendered screen reader only, so anything visible is up to the children.

fab.description: Fixed position action button. The preview box below is a containing block for it, so it pins to the box corner instead of the viewport corner.

form.description: Radix form parts. FormControl is used with asChild so the native validity state drives FormMessage without any validation library.
form.label: Email

input.description: Plain input element with cva variants. Its size prop is the variant scale, not the native size attribute, which it shadows.

loader.description: Animated bars from a plain stylesheet. Returns null while closed, and passing onClick swaps the wrapper for a button. The preview box below is a containing block, so a fullScreen loader covers the box instead of the page.

modal.description: Radix dialog centred in a dimmed overlay. Controlled only: it takes open plus onClose, traps focus while it is up, and restores focus on close.
modal.title: Modal content
modal.body: Clicking the overlay outside the panel closes it, and so does Escape.

note.description: Accent panel with a themed left border. Text only by design, so it cannot hold markup.
note.text: Notes take a text prop, not children.

popover.description: The trigger is a prop, not a child, and is rendered with asChild. Uncontrolled only, portalled, pinned to sideOffset 8 with align end.
popover.body: Anything can go in here. The close button slot sits above the children.

radio_group.description: Radix radio group with the dot indicator baked into the item. Composed: the root only supplies layout and roving focus.

select.description: Closed API over the Radix select: items come from an options array rather than children. The keyboard variant turns the dropdown into a keycap list.

separator.description: Radix separator, always decorative, so it never lands in the accessibility tree. A vertical one needs a parent with a resolved height.

slider.description: Controlled only. The thumb count comes from the length of the value tuple, and minStepsBetweenThumbs is pinned to 1 so a range cannot cross itself.

sortable_list.description: Drag and drop list on dnd-kit, generic over anything with an id. Items are a render prop, and onChange receives the already reordered array.

switch.description: Radix switch with the thumb baked in. Fixed size, no variants, and the checked track picks up the current accent.
switch.label: Shuffle

tabs.description: Radix tabs, composed from list, triggers and content. Manual activation means arrow keys move focus without switching panel until Enter or Space.

textarea.description: Plain textarea with the same variant and size vocabulary as Input. The size scale sets a min height, so the box still grows with rows.

toast.description: Controlled Radix toast that ships its own provider and viewport per instance and portals to the body. Swipe it right to dismiss.

toggle.description: Radix toggle. The icon prop is required, so it always renders one, and children become an optional label after it.

toggle_group.description: Shares the toggle variants and pushes them to its items through context. The type prop changes the shape of value, so single and multiple are separate branches.

tooltip.description: Ships its own provider per instance at a 200ms delay. The trigger focuses itself on click so the tooltip is reachable on touch.
tooltip.content: Tooltips take children as their content
